Application Data.NAME: XYZ Printing Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: XYZ Printing Solutions offers a variety of printing and copying services, including digital printing, color copying, and document finishing. We specialize in serving small businesses and individuals in our local community, providing high-quality printed materials such as business cards, brochures, and flyers. Our operations are conducted in a controlled retail environment with minimal foot traffic and no use of commercial vehicles for delivery, ensuring a low exposure to transportation-related risks. We prioritize the safety and proper handling of our inks and materials, and we maintain robust risk management protocols to mitigate any potential issues. In addition to our core services, we provide basic notary services, all while adhering to compliance regulations and best practices in the printing industry.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, we experienced a minor water leak that resulted in damage to our printing equipment. The cause was a malfunctioning air conditioning unit. The total repair costs amounted to $3,000, and the claim was successfully settled. The equipment has since been repaired and is fully operational.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the premises and daily monitoring by a professional security service.
